entries.title: Successful LTE Attach and Detach with Single UE under Excellent Radio Conditions
steps: Start logging to capture call flow and signalling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate LTE attach
Wait for attach complete message confirming successful attach
Power OFF the UE to initiate LTE detach
Wait for detach accept message confirming successful detach
Stop and save the logs
Repeat above attach-detach steps for total 10 iterations
expected_results: Attach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations
Detach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations
Attach latency measured and recorded for each iteration
UE logs confirm attachment to correct LTE cell (PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN)
Signalling messages validate correct attach and detach procedures as per 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1 and 5.3.8.2.1

entries.title: Successful 5G NSA Attach and Detach with Single UE under Excellent Radio Conditions
steps: Start logging to capture call flow and signalling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate 5G NSA attach
Wait for attach complete message confirming successful attach
Validate secondary node addition by checking SgNB addition request and SgNB reconfiguration complete messages
Power OFF the UE to initiate 5G NSA detach
Wait for detach accept message confirming successful detach
Validate secondary node release by checking SgNB release request and acknowledge messages and RRC connection reconfiguration
Stop and save the logs
Repeat above attach-detach steps for total 10 iterations
expected_results: Attach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations
Secondary node addition success rate is 100% over 10 iterations
Detach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations
UE logs confirm attachment to correct LTE and NR cells (PCI, Global eNB ID/Global gNB ID, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN)

Signalling messages validate correct attach, secondary node addition, detach, and secondary node release procedures as per 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1, 5.3.8.2.1 and 3GPP TS 37.340 Clauses 10.2.1 and 10.4.1
messages: SgNB addition request and SgNB reconfiguration complete messages Power OFF the UE to initiate
SgNB release request and acknowledge messages and RRC connection reconfiguration Stop and save the logs Repeat above attach

entries.title: Attach Failure Due to Poor Radio Conditions
steps: Start logging to capture call flow and signalling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate attach
Wait and observe attach procedure outcome
Stop and save the logs
expected_results: Attach procedure fails due to poor radio conditions
Attach success rate is 0%
Signalling logs indicate attach request but no attach complete or failure messages
UE logs indicate failure or timeout in attach procedure

entries.title: Detach Failure Due to Signalling Message Loss
steps: Start logging to capture call flow and signalling messages
Power OFF the UE to initiate detach
Simulate drop or delay of detach accept or UE Context Release message in network
Observe system behavior and UE state
Stop and save the logs
expected_results: Detach procedure incomplete or fails due to missing detach accept
UE may remain in connected state or retry detach
Network resources not released properly
Signalling logs show missing or delayed detach accept or context release
System handles failure gracefully without crash

entries.title: Attach and Detach with Latency Measurement at Boundary Radio Conditions
steps: Start logging to capture call flow and signalling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate attach
Wait for attach complete
Power OFF the UE to initiate detach
Wait for detach accept
Stop and save the logs
Repeat above steps 10 times
Calculate minimum, average, and maximum attach latency
expected_results: Attach and detach success rates close to 100%, may have occasional failures
Attach latency may be higher or more variable compared to ideal conditions
Latency values recorded and sorted in ascending order
UE logs confirm attachment to correct cell

entries.title: Stress Test: Attach and Detach Repeated 100 Times Under Excellent Radio Conditions
steps: Start logging to capture call flow and signalling messages
Repeat attach and detach procedure 100 consecutive times:
- Power ON UE, wait for attach complete
- Power OFF UE, wait for detach accept
Stop and save the logs
Calculate attach and detach success rates and latency statistics
expected_results: Attach and detach success rates remain at or near 100% over 100 iterations
System sustains continuous attach-detach without degradation or crash
Attach latency remains within acceptable range as per baseline
No memory leaks or resource exhaustion observed

entries.title: Attach Procedure Authentication Failure
steps: Start logging to capture call flow and signalling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate attach
Observe authentication procedure messages
Wait for authentication failure indication or reject message
Stop and save the logs
expected_results: Attach procedure fails at authentication step
Network rejects attach request with appropriate cause
UE logs indicate authentication failure
No UE context established in network
Attach success rate is 0%

entries.title: Integration Test of Secondary Node Release Procedure Initiated by Master Node (MN)
steps: Start logging to capture signalling messages
Trigger MN initiated SgNB Release Request message
Observe SN sending SgNB Release Request Acknowledge message
Verify MN sends RRCConnectionReconfiguration message to UE to release SCG configuration
Verify SN sends SN Status Transfer and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report messages
Verify SN releases UE context and radio/C-plane resources upon UE Context Release message
Stop and save logs
expected_results: MN initiates release correctly and SN confirms release
UE receives RRCConnectionReconfiguration and releases SCG configuration
SN transfers status and data usage reports correctly
Resources released properly at SN
Procedure aligns with signalling flow in Figure 10.4.1-1
messages: SgNB Release Request message Observe SN sending SgNB Release Request Acknowledge message Verify MN sends RRCConnectionReconfiguration message to UE to release SCG configuration Verify SN sends SN Status Transfer and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report messages Verify SN releases UE context and radio

entries.title: Integration Test of Secondary Node Release Procedure Initiated by Secondary Node (SN)
steps: Start logging to capture signalling messages
Trigger SN initiated SgNB Release Required message
Observe MN sends SgNB Release Confirm message with data forwarding addresses
Verify MN sends RRCConnectionReconfiguration message to UE to release SCG configuration
Verify SN sends SN Status Transfer and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report messages
Verify SN releases UE context and radio/C-plane resources upon UE Context Release message
Stop and save logs
expected_results: SN initiates release correctly and MN confirms release
UE receives RRCConnectionReconfiguration and releases SCG configuration
SN transfers status and data usage reports correctly
Resources released properly at SN
Procedure aligns with signalling flow in Figure 10.4.1-2
messages: SgNB Release Required message Observe MN sends SgNB Release Confirm message with data forwarding addresses Verify MN sends RRCConnectionReconfiguration message to UE to release SCG configuration Verify SN sends SN Status Transfer and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report messages Verify SN releases UE context and radio

entries.title: Verify Clarity of UE Logs and Test Report for Attach-Detach Procedure
steps: Review UE logs and test report for completeness
Check presentation of KPIs such as attach success rate, detach success rate, attach latency
Verify radio parameters like RSRP and RSRQ are recorded
Confirm test configuration parameters are documented
Verify that report clearly indicates pass/fail criteria and gap analysis
expected_results: Logs and report are complete and easy to interpret
All required KPIs are presented clearly in tables similar to Table 5-2 and Table 5-3
Configuration parameters are fully documented
Pass/fail criteria and gap analysis are included and understandable

entries.title: Attach and Detach Test Across Multiple UE Emulator Platforms
steps: For each UE platform:
- Configure test setup with single UE under excellent radio conditions
- Start logging
- Power ON UE to attach
- Wait for attach complete
- Power OFF UE to detach
- Wait for detach accept
- Stop logging and save results
- Record attach/detach success rates and latency
expected_results: Attach and detach success rates are near 100% across all UE platforms
Attach latency within acceptable range for each platform
No platform-specific failures or inconsistencies observed
Logs confirm correct cell attachment and signalling
